people.name: EDGREN, Hjalmar – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.evidence: in 1870 started studies at Yale. Ph.D. there 1874 (diss. on Romance linguistics)

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.evidence: then taught French and studied further under Whitney.

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.evidence: Back in Sweden he worked as a Docent of Sanskrit at Lund University in 1880-84.

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit and Modern Languages
relations.evidence: From 1884 Professor of Sanskrit and Modern Languages at Nebraska University in Lincoln.

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.evidence: in 1891-93 Professor of Germanic Languages at the newly founded Göteborg Högskola (future Gothenburg University) in Sweden

relations.subject: August Hjalmar Edgren
relations.role: Professor of Romance Languages, and Professor of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology
relations.evidence: returned to his chair in Lincoln. There he was also Professor of Romance Languages from 1893, and Professor of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology, until 1901.
